procedure: Validate all shared manifest declarations and the numeric v1 configuration content.
Refuse immutable content and paths in runs, events, artifacts or evidence. This operation grants no mutation authority.
Require exactly one root schemaVersion key. Replace only its numeric token 1 with the current identifier, without parsing and serializing authored data.
Preserve every other byte, including unknown properties, duplicate non-identity keys, numeric lexemes, prompts, whitespace, safety settings and protocol versions.
Validate destination content. Compare preservation snapshots with only the schema token removed.
Use the shared locked atomic writer. Rejection leaves source bytes unchanged. Current input remains byte-identical.
immutableHistory: No run, manifest, result, progress or judgement upgrade is declared. Use historical readers.
